mapper.delete: delete cart where cart_owner=#{cartOwner} and cart_item=#{cartItem}
mapper.select:
select
S.sale_no, S.sale_name, S.sale_category, S.sale_original_price, S.sale_discount_price, S.sale_reg_time, C.cart_qty, ST.attach_no
from cart C
inner join sale S on C.cart_item = S.sale_no left outer join sale_thumbnail ST on S.sale_no = ST.sale_no
where C.cart_owner = #{cartOwner}
order by cart_item asc
